title: Nice box, but....
text:
Nice box, but..... UPDATE 2019 06 08 - I upped my review for this from 3 to 4 stars as I can see the price is more reasonable now. Wish the dividers didn't have notches in them. It would be useful for so many more things, like storing beads and gemstones, etc. Unfortunately, with the notches, these kinds of things just spill over from one compartment to the other, unless they are large enough so they don't fit through the notches.

It's a nice box, and I bought 3 (Sept 5, Sept 18). Was coming back for several more, but the price just went up by over 53%!!!! Just lost interest. I even recommended this product on several other similar listings, citing the price. Vendor is human and the greed took over. I will remove my recommendations.

This happens so often on Amazon. I am loathe to leave good reviews anymore because so many vendors don't realize that the price they are offering products for plays a big role in their popularity. And, while we can all allow for a small price hike every now and again, to keep up with inflation, this kind of ridiculous price hike is just plain gouging.
